items.exampleEn: He is so arrogant that he never listens to anyone.
items.exampleZh: 他傲慢到從來不聽任何人說話。

items.exampleEn: Being corrected in front of the whole office was a humiliation for him.
items.exampleZh: 當著整個辦公室的人被糾正，讓他覺得很丟臉。

items.exampleEn: My little sister adores her new kitten.
items.exampleZh: 我妹妹超愛她的新小貓。

items.exampleEn: A compassionate neighbor brought us food when my father lost his job.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸失業時，一位好心的鄰居送食物給我們。

items.exampleEn: She aspires to become a pilot.
We were touched by the generosity of strangers when our car broke down.
items.exampleZh: 我們的車拋錨時，陌生人的慷慨讓我們很感動。

items.exampleEn: He was too irresponsible to look after the class plants.
items.exampleZh: 他太不負責任了，照顧不好班上的植物。

items.exampleEn: Dance is a very expressive art form.
items.exampleZh: 舞蹈是一種很有表現力的藝術形式。
items.glossZh: 富有表現力的；表情豐富的

items.sentenceEn: Many young players aspire to play for the national team.
items.sentenceZh: 很多年輕球員都渴望進國家隊打球。

items.audioEn: My grandmother adores gardening; she spends every morning outside with her flowers.
items.audioZh: 我奶奶非常喜歡園藝，每天早上都在外面照顧她的花。
items.questionZh: 奶奶早上通常在做什麼？
options: She spends every morning in bed
She buys new flowers every morning
She takes care of her plants
She goes for a long walk

items.sentenceEn: It was irresponsible of him to lose the keys to the office.
items.sentenceZh: 他把辦公室的鑰匙弄丟了，真是不負責任。

items.sentenceEn: Don't be arrogant; everyone makes mistakes.
items.sentenceZh: 別自以為了不起，每個人都會犯錯。

items.stemEn: Leaving young children alone at home all night is ____.
items.stemZh: 整晚把年幼的孩子單獨留在家是不負責任的。

items.stemEn: Thanks to the ____ of local people, the school raised enough money for a new library.
items.stemZh: 多虧當地人的慷慨，學校募到了足夠蓋新圖書館的錢。

items.passageEn: Our new drama teacher used to be a famous actor, so at first some students thought she might be arrogant. She was the opposite. She is compassionate and patient, and she adores working with young people. In her first class, she showed us how expressive a face can be without any words. When one boy forgot his lines on stage, she did not let him feel any humiliation; she made a joke and helped him continue. She even buys our costumes with her own money, and we are all thankful for her generosity. She says it would be irresponsible to send anyone on stage before they are ready. How she remembers all eighty of our names still mystifies us, and many of us now aspire to act like her.
items.passageZh: 我們新的戲劇老師以前是有名的演員，所以一開始有些學生以為她會很傲慢。結果正好相反。她有同情心又有耐心，而且非常喜歡和年輕人一起工作。第一堂課，她就示範一張臉不說話也能多麼有表情。有個男生在台上忘詞時，她沒有讓他覺得難堪，而是開了個玩笑，幫他接著演下去。她甚至自己出錢幫我們買戲服，我們都很感謝她的慷慨。她說，在大家準備好之前就讓人上台是不負責任的。她怎麼記得住我們八十個人的名字，到現在還是讓我們想不通，很多人現在也希望自己能演得像她一樣。

questions.questionZh: 那個男生忘詞時，老師怎麼做？
options: 要大家一起大聲念台詞給他聽
請他先下台，換別人上去演

questions.questionZh: 大家的戲服是怎麼來的？
options: 學校另外撥了一筆經費

referenceEn: She is very compassionate toward others.
She is a very compassionate person.
rubricZh: compassionate 的用法，例如 compassionate toward others、a compassionate person 等
時態合理（例如 is 等）

items.promptZh: 這位老演員深受全國觀眾的喜愛。
referenceEn: Audiences all over the country adore this veteran actor.
This veteran actor is adored by audiences across the country.
rubricZh: adore 表示「非常喜愛」，主動或被動都可以（例如 audiences adore him、is adored by 等）
「全國觀眾」可寫，例如 audiences all over the country、people across the country 等
「老演員」可寫，例如 veteran actor 等
